q: Jewett-Krieger theorem states that every ergodic measure-preserving system (X,μ,T) is:
opts: Measurably isomorphic to a uniquely ergodic minimal topological system
Orbit equivalent to an irrational rotation
exp: Jewett-Krieger: every ergodic system can be realised as a uniquely ergodic minimal homeomorphism of a compact metric space. This shows the abstract measure-theoretic category contains all topological systems—and topological systems can realise any abstract ergodic system.
